title: ChatGPT and ACP: the 2025 Instant Checkout model, the 2026 discovery-first model and ChatGPT Wallet
caption: In 2025 ChatGPT ran the full ACP checkout in chat. On 2026-03-24 OpenAI let merchants use their own checkout and extended ACP to product feeds and discovery. On 2026-11-13 it added ChatGPT Wallet in dots: the user approves each purchase, the card network issues a payment token, and the dot pays on the merchant's existing checkout; OpenAI does not present Wallet as ACP. The 'moving to apps' quote is reported only, and no primary source gives a shutdown date for Instant Checkout.
alt: Three panels. 2025 model: buyer in ChatGPT, ChatGPT runs ACP create, update and complete, a Delegate Payment token such as a Stripe SPT, and the merchant charges as merchant of record. 2026 model: the merchant pushes product feeds through ACP directly or through providers, the buyer discovers in ChatGPT, then checks out on the merchant site (generally available) or, for select partners, through the payment sheet in plugins (private beta). An arrow labeled scaled back 2026-03-24 joins the first two panels. Third panel, from 2026-11-13, ChatGPT Wallet in dots, not ACP: the user approves each purchase with a security check, the card network issues a payment token, and the dot pays on the merchant's existing checkout page. A dashed arrow labeled added beside discovery 2026-11-13 joins the second and third panels.

sourceOfTruth.label: OpenAI, Powering product discovery in ChatGPT (2026-03-24), and Introducing ChatGPT Wallet (2026-11-13)
